newsitem.title: LATVIA: Latvia's Ventspils Jan-Sept oil volume rises.
newsitem.headline: Latvia's Ventspils Jan-Sept oil volume rises.

text.p: The volume of crude oil and refined products handled by Latvia's Ventspils terminal rose to 18.81 million tonnes in the first nine months of the year versus 14.81 million in the same 1995 period, the port said on Wednesday.
A company statement said 10.67 million tonnes of crude had passed through the port by the end of September, against 12.09 million in the whole of 1995.
The volume of diesel handled by the end of September was 7.18 million tonnes, compared with 6.73 million in the whole of 1995, it added.
It said it would exceed last year's total volume of 19.95 million of tonnes of crude and oil products during the course of November.
